planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno; no PWM/Timer constraints are introduced in device requests. Model must handle compressor/relay hysteresis, temperature conversion (LM35 scale/offset), and door-open duration timing using elapsed_ms.
LM35 reading is provided via analog_input on A1; model must convert ADC to °C and compare with upper/lower bounds (not specified in prose).

Door magnet switch electrical polarity (active-high vs active-low) is not specified. digital_input uses catalog default unless circuit facts exist; to avoid double inversion, model should interpret 'pressed/closed contact' as true when the electrical level corresponds to the catalog default.
The system uses D10 for fan/compressor relay; default initial is off. Model must drive start/stop based on temperature control requirements.
Buzzer on D6 is configured as tone_output with invalid_policy silence and initial 0; model must set tone frequency and stop behavior.

TM1637 displays 'current temperature and door opened duration' but the exact display format (how to multiplex/alternate between temperature and duration on the same 4-digit display, rounding/units, decimal point use) is not specified; model must define the representation.

Serial protocol/text is not specified except baud/framing. Assumption: first serial channel emits a continuous i32 code while the critical condition holds; second channel emits temperature and door-open seconds when not critical. If a fixed text line is required by the original protocol, it must be specified and should use serial_text_output with that exact fixed text.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: LM35 temperature sensor input for refrigerator control

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Fan/compressor relay command (制冷继电器 启停)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer alarm tone for door opened too long

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display for current temperature and door-open duration indication

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: Status LED (door-open alarm blinking and/or temperature critical indication as defined by model)

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Gate: output continuous critical cooling loss when temperature is above upper limit and door is not closed

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Critical cooling loss state code (model-defined), emitted continuously while the critical condition holds

interfaces.name: serial_1_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Gate: report current temperature and door-open time while not in critical cooling loss mode

interfaces.name: serial_1_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Current temperature to be displayed/reported (model uses LM35 conversion and thresholds)

interfaces.name: serial_1_value_1
interfaces.meaning: Door opened duration in seconds (model time accumulation)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个实验室冰箱温控与门开监测系统，使用 LM35（A1）、门磁开关 D2、风扇/制冷继电器 D10、蜂鸣器 D6、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和串口。系统根据温度控制制冷继电器启停；当门连续打开超过 10 秒时蜂鸣器报警并闪烁 LED；若温度高于上限且门未关闭，则串口持续输出 critical cooling loss。TM1637 显示当前温度和门打开时长。
